strings.ui.demo.title: Glad you’re here!
strings.ui.demo.body:
What you’re about to play is an early demo of ASHES OF EMPIRES: THE LAST WINTER – chapters 1 to 4, about an hour of story between Karsk and Berlin.

Everything is still a work in progress: graphics, music and text are being improved all the time, and the story will grow by many more chapters – with new places, secrets and decisions.

Thank you for playing! Every bit of feedback, every idea and every bug you find helps us enormously. And wrap up warm – it’s going to be a long winter.
